summary: Frontend-only verification of the 502 Bad Gateway fix on preview URL https://saas-architect-15.preview.emergentagent.com. Supervisor programs (aio-bootstrap EXITED after completing bootstrap, mariadb RUNNING, redis RUNNING, laravel RUNNING, horizon RUNNING) are healthy. All 9 review checks executed; 8 passed cleanly, 1 partial (wrong-password activation banner text could not be verified because provider username test_active had already been consumed by the successful activation earlier in the same run — as anticipated in the review note). ZERO 502 responses and ZERO 5xx responses observed across the entire test run.

per_check_results.landing_page: PASS — 200, 'AIO Rewards' and 'Turn your AIO Media' both rendered.
per_check_results.activate_page: PASS — 200, all 9 activate-* data-testid fields present (form, provider-username, provider-password, name, email, password, password-confirmation, consent, submit).
per_check_results.admin_login_page: PASS — 200, Filament sign-in form renders, no >=400 asset requests captured.
per_check_results.login_verified_ambassador: PASS — redirected to /ambassador/dashboard; rendered 'Preview Verified Ambassador', 'preview-verified@example.com', 'PREVIEW1', '/r/PREVIEW1', [data-testid=copy-referral-link] present, [data-testid=dash-status] text = 'Active'.
per_check_results.logout: PASS — [data-testid=nav-logout] click returned to landing '/'; subsequent GET /ambassador/dashboard redirected to /login (session cleared).
per_check_results.activation_success_flow: PASS — provider_username=test_active + provider_password=letmein + fresh email -> redirected to /email/verify. No 502, 403, or 419.
per_check_results.activation_wrong_password_banner: PARTIAL — page stayed on /activate with inline error and no 5xx/419. BUT the specific banner text 'could not verify' could not be verified because the fake provider driver returned 'This provider username has already been used to activate an AIO Rewards account.' (test_active had been consumed by the preceding success test). Provider-invalid-credentials error banner text was NOT re-testable in this run without a fresh provider username. No 502.
per_check_results.forgot_password_post: PASS — GET returned 200, POST returned 302 to /forgot-password, follow-up page contained flash-status content. No 502.

action_items: Consider adding a second reusable fake provider username (e.g. test_active2) so wrong-password + already-used-username scenarios can be tested independently in one CI run.
aio-bootstrap supervisor program shows EXITED (expected once bootstrap finishes) — confirm this is intentionally a one-shot program (autorestart=false) and not a stealth failure.
critical_code_review_comments: Bootstrap depends on apt reinstalling PHP + MariaDB + Redis on every recycled pod — this is a slow cold-start (~30s+). Long-term: bake dependencies into the container image rather than reinstalling via aio-bootstrap.

PreviewAmbassadorSeeder uses forceFill for email_verified_at — good workaround, but the root cause (User model missing email_verified_at in $fillable) should be fixed to avoid re-hitting this in other seeders.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (0/9 hard failures; 8 full-pass, 1 partial due to consumed test fixture — no 502)

test_credentials: preview-verified@example.com / previewpass1234 (referral PREVIEW1); fake provider test_active/letmein (single-use per fresh DB).
seed_data_creation: None created directly by testing agent; PreviewAmbassadorSeeder auto-created preview-verified@example.com and activation flow created two new ambassadors during testing (newamb1785859613398@example.com, badamb1785859670787@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 502 fix is verified end-to-end. Supervisor keeps `php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=3000` (program 'laravel') and Horizon alive. If you need to re-run the wrong-provider-password test after the DB is warm, you must either (a) reset the DB / re-run seeders, or (b) use a NEW fake-provider username not present in ambassadors table. The fake provider driver in Phase 1 exposes only 'test_active' as an eligible username — any repeat use of it after a successful activation collides on the 'already used' guard, masking the credentials-invalid path.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 502: pod recycles killed the ad-hoc `php artisan serve` background process and apt-installed system packages. Fix (verified working): supervisor conf at /etc/supervisor/conf.d/aio-rewards.conf runs aio-bootstrap (idempotent PHP 8.4 + MariaDB + Redis + composer + migrations + seeders) then keeps laravel + horizon + mariadb + redis processes alive with autorestart. Preview URL now returns 200/302 across all tested routes with no 502.
